summary: Iteration 8: Verified dynamic OAuth redirect_uri validation and callback state persistence. Created 14 new tests covering whitelist validation, mongo state persistence, and callback flow. All 113 backend tests pass (99 previous regression + 14 new).
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_redirect_uri correctly enforces suffix match (host == suf.lstrip('.') OR host.endswith(suf)); lookalike hosts like foo.emergent.host.evil.com are properly rejected because the check is on host suffix, and evil.com host does not match .emergent.host suffix.
Callback correctly reads redirect_uri from state_doc and reuses it in token exchange (server.py:198,207), preventing AADSTS7000215 mismatch across preview/prod.
server.py is 868 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold; consider splitting auth/maps/files into separate routers in a future iteration.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests create ephemeral oauth_states docs and clean them up. Additionally purged 77 stale oauth_states leftover from previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 fix validated: backend now accepts dynamic redirect_uri from frontend, validates via _validate_redirect_uri against ALLOWED_REDIRECT_SUFFIXES (*.preview.emergentagent.com, *.emergent.host, localhost:3000, 127.0.0.1:3000) and requires '/auth/callback' suffix. Stored redirect_uri is reused in callback token exchange. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_dynamic_redirect.py. Full suite: 113 passing.
verified_scenarios: Production redirect (emergent.host) accepted and used in url
oauth_states doc contains correct redirect_uri (custom and fallback)
callback with invalid state → 400 Invalid state
callback with valid state + fake code → 400 Token exchange failed (NOT AADSTS7000215, proving stored redirect_uri matches)
